title: App Studio 改版（1-1）：左侧菜单照前端样式——分组标题可折叠、线条图标不带底色、选中用胶囊加竖条；定义 Studio 专用石墨色
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: topic #37424 — parent decisions 4 and 5; the maintainer's 「左侧菜单的分类效果也参考前端」「左侧菜单选中效果也和前端保持一致」「可以不要背景」「Studio 应该是一个专用的企业色，不需要和应用的企业色一致。防止晕了」 (2026-11-26, quoted on #37424), and his pick 「按推荐启动」 of phase 1 (2026-11-26 05:57Z). Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 1, P1-1).
Grade: area:ux · Feature · p2 (takes the parent's grade) · evidence: mockup 1 (#37424 comment 7181963746, `Main.png`) and the current menu read on origin/main 7d50dc8b.
Reader: area `ux-37424` (seat `repo:objectstack#5`), an `os-dev` subagent.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：Studio 左侧菜单和前端应用的菜单长得一样——分组标题可以折叠，图标是线条图标、没有底色方块，选中项是缩进的胶囊加左侧竖条；选中色用 Studio 自己的石墨色，不再跟应用的主题色。
- 为什么先做它：每个 Studio 页面都看得到，改动最小，不用等 ADR，也不碰 4 号座位还没合的 PR #37383。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioMenu.tsx` already renders with the front end's `Sidebar` primitive (~lines 43–55). Restyle it to match the front-end app menu: group headers collapsible the way `ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx` uses `Collapsible`; line icons with no tile; the selected item uses the front end's inset pill and left bar; spacing as the front end.
- Define the Studio accent (graphite, neutral) in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studio-tokens.ts` and use it for the menu's selected / hover states. Only the app logo keeps the app's colour (decision 4). Mounting the accent on the whole Studio root waits for PR #37383 and rides P1-4.
- ⛔ Do not edit `ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` itself: the front-end menus would change with it. Reuse, do not fork, the front end's menu pieces; if a piece is not exported, export it rather than copy it.
- ⛔ Do not touch `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` or the top bar: PR #37383 edits that file, and P1-5 deletes the top bar.

## Acceptance

- The Studio menu matches mockup 1's left column in grouping, icons and selection, in light and dark.
- The selected colour is the graphite token whatever the app's theme colour is (a test pins it with a non-default app theme).
- No change to front-end app menus (the existing layout / sidebar tests stay green untouched).

File surface: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioMenu.tsx`, `studio-tokens.ts`, their tests, a menu-piece export in `ui/packages/layout` only if needed, one changeset.
Governing text: `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md` (menu), parent decisions 4–5.
